prompts.text: What is something people assume is easy about your day that actually takes effort?

Have you ever changed your mind about a style of art or architecture after learning more about it?
A friend calls a building ugly but you love it. How would you explain what you see?
Describe a moment when the light transformed somewhere familiar into something new.
